stem.text: A projectile is fired from point P with velocity $V$ at an angle $\theta$ to the horizontal. It lands at point Q, a horizontal distance $R$ from P, after time $T$.

stem.alt: Diagram of a projectile path from P to Q, with velocity V at angle θ to a horizontal dashed line, and horizontal distance R marked between P and Q.

stem.text: The acceleration of free fall is $g$. Air resistance is negligible.
